Front wheel/tire/hubcap (steel wheel with chrome hubcap, whitewall) | left front wheel, stationary, fully visible in 3/4 view | partially visible in side close-up, same orientation, stationary | no rotation or position change without cause
Windshield wipers (pair) | resting at base of windshield, parallel, parked position | still resting at same base position in close-up | no actuation
